messages:
tara-ciso: Auditor sent a targeted evidence request for a policy change that removed `S3:ListBucket` from the service-account role and led to a secrets rotation on 2025-12-01. They want: the Git PR, CloudTrail entries for IAM changes, KMS key usage showing encrypt/decrypt and key version, SecretsManager rotation log, and the decision ticket. Who can gather and sanitize this?
leo-sre: I can pull CloudTrail and IAM change events. Prefer to provide a CSV with only: eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.principalId, requestID, resources. We should redact IPs and user emails.
auditor-rep: CSV is fine. Include eventIDs and any referenced ARNs. For KMS we need to see GenerateDataKey/Encrypt calls with keyVersion or keyId and timestamps. If you can tie the KMS events to the secret rotation that helps.
hana-platsec: I'll collect the SecretsManager rotation history and the Jira ticket SEC-847. Note: the secrets were rotated via our automation; SecretsManager shows PreviousVersionStatus -> 'Deprecated' and new version Active. We will include a small mapping doc that explains field names.
tara-ciso: Also include the PR diff and approval history. The PR is in infra-access: https://github.com/redwood/infra-access/pull/912 — make sure to include the merge commit hash.
devops-bot: evidence-export started: job-id 2145 -> s3://redwood-evidence/exports/2792237000/ (presigned links pending)
leo-sre: CloudTrail query I'm running (CloudWatch Logs Insights):
```
fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters.policyDocument, eventID
| filter @timestamp >= '2025-12-01T00:00:00Z' and @timestamp <= '2025-12-02T00:00:00Z' and (eventName in ['PutRolePolicy','UpdateAssumeRolePolicy','AttachRolePolicy','DetachRolePolicy'])
| sort @timestamp asc
```
I'll export as cloudtrail_rbac_2792237000.csv.gz and remove requestPayload.user.email fields.
auditor-rep: Redacting emails/IPs is acceptable. Keep principalId values as `role/` or `user/` so auditors can map roles.
hana-platsec: Secrets export done: secrets_rotation_2792237000.csv contains secretId,rotationTimestamp,previousVersionStatus,newVersionId. I've redacted actual secret values.
tara-ciso: For KMS: can we include CMK ARN and the GenerateDataKey events that reference keyId and a dataKeySpec? Auditor wants to see that rotation of the key preceded re-encryption of the secret.
leo-sre: KMS logs show CreateKey/EnableKeyRotation/RotateKey occurred earlier in the week and a key policy change at 2025-11-30T22:45:10Z. We have Encrypt events at 2025-12-01T03:05:41Z against key/ef12-aaaa that line up with the SecretsManager rotation. I'll include kms_activity_2792237000.csv with columns eventTime,eventName,userIdentity.principalId,requestParameters.keyId,eventID.
auditor-rep: Please also include the ticket/approval evidence showing the business reason for the RBAC change and who approved. Role names OK to keep, personal emails can be redacted.
hana-platsec: Ticket SEC-847 exported as JSON (redacted): includes summary, timeline, approvers ["Security Lead","Platform Manager"] and resolution notes.
devops-bot: evidence-export update: job-id 2145 -> uploads: cloudtrail_rbac_2792237000.csv.gz, kms_activity_2792237000.csv, secrets_rotation_2792237000.csv, jira_SEC-847.json, pr_912_patch.txt
tara-ciso: One auditor asked for a control mapping doc. I'll add control_mapping_2792237000.csv mapping artifacts to SOC 2 CC6.1, CC6.5 and ISO 27001 A.9.2, A.12.5.1. Short narrative included: how RBAC change triggered rotation, verification steps performed, and who signed off.
auditor-rep: Good. If possible, provide a short timeline CSV: timeline_2792237000.csv with rows timestamp,event,artifact_link. That speeds our review.
leo-sre: Creating timeline now. Also note: PR 912 was merged by @infra-bot; approvals by @mike and @laura. Merge commit: d4f7a8c. Adding the PR permalink and diff as pr_912_patch.txt.
hana-platsec: Generating presigned links with 5-day TTL. README.txt will include redaction policy and field glossary.
devops-bot: evidence-export complete: job-id 2145 -> 6 files uploaded, presigned links emailed to auditor@audit-firm.com
auditor-rep: Received email, thanks. We'll validate mapping to our control matrix and reach out only if we need raw payloads.
tara-ciso: Thanks team. If the auditor requests deeper logs (raw requestPayloads) we will route through legal and redact PII before release. Closing this thread.
